items: Leaderboard fix: old records that dropped off (e.g. big Starlight multis) are back
Wins and snake runs that are still in progress during a server update now count
New event: 🥤 Shell Game – follow the stone under 3 cups, 5 rounds, faster each time
Labyrinth: driving into a dead end sends you back to the start
Mystery box Jackpot: +50 length (was +12)
Poker: no more flickering cards, big win banner with coin rain and sounds
Leaderboard: every win counts for Best multi (e.g. Starlight) and Biggest win too
No more default music – Sunny pop is now in the Cosmetic Shop (18,000)
Default music is now Sunny pop: quieter, upbeat, with a beat
Arena: drag & drop items onto weapon, armor, backpack and Q/G slots
Equip tab shows your stash – drag a slot back to take it off
Raid inventory: drag from the backpack onto slots and back
Arena: smoother movement, no more getting stuck on corners
Boss: the Raccoon King roams the map every 2–10 min – kill him for 3 Sovereign-tier drops
Supply drops with gear every 3–6 min, announced 15 s ahead
Crates now only give grenades and heals
Box obstacles removed from the map
Salvage gives less scrap
Free default music for everyone: Sunny jazz
Leaderboard: every run counts, you can hold several spots
New name: Kek-Game, new address game.flashkeks.com
New logo: raccoon with beer and döner
Main menu with Games, Gamba and Kekémon (coming soon)
Cosmetic Shop banner right in the menu, with countdown
Events: fewer coins, three times more length
Salvaging several items always asks first and shows the scrap
ESC always takes you one menu back
Patch notes live here now
Slots: the feed no longer spoils a big win before the reels stop
Arena hub split into Equip, Inventory and Salvage
Equip: click a slot to pick from matching items
Salvage: one click for all Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic
Compact cards (Rare · ⚡ score), details on hover
Backpacks: new slot, 12 to 50 raid slots
Raid inventory in the middle, Apex style
Burning is quiet: just a red edge for the one who burns
Railgun: instant beam through walls, 250 damage
Fat Boy: real mini nuke with mushroom cloud
Singularity: every hit opens a black hole
Glowing tracers from Epic up, rockets, magic orbs, new sounds
Arena: rarity rolled per case, Legendary to Ultra rare
New cases: Mage, Demolition, Sovereign (100k)
Special items from Epic up: Flamethrower, Railgun, Fat Boy …
Effects equally rare on every tier
Two consumable slots (Q/G): nuke, black hole, flashbang, blink …
Armor only from cases and crates
Doors on buildings are visible
Arena: helmet, vest, pants, boots with set bonuses
Grenades, hiding in buildings, bushes and smoke
Slow health regeneration, raid inventory (Tab)
Arena becomes an extraction shooter: loadout, loot crates, extraction zones
Cases, shop, salvage to scrap
Cosmetic Shop: 134 designs, daily and weekly offers
Poker lobbies, Plinko, blackjack side bets
Achievements with titles, stats, leaderboard filters
Map events: Maze, Coin Rush, Last Snake Standing
